headline: Hāna committee backs land change for clinic housing and specialty clinic

meeting.body: Hana Advisory Committee to the Maui Planning Commission
meeting.summary: The committee voted five in favor to recommend approval of a land change for Hāna Health workforce housing and a specialty clinic.
meeting.recap: The chair said he has no financial or other interest in Hāna Health beyond being a client, and would not step aside.[[0:09:30]] Staff said the meeting's notice requirements were met.[[0:12:07]] The only item was a public hearing on a Council resolution to change Hāna Health Center land from the state agriculture district to the rural district.[[0:14:18]] One resident testified in support of the change.[[0:16:08]] The change would allow six workforce housing units and a specialty clinic.[[0:18:09]] A member asked whether the housing could give priority to Hāna residents.[[0:30:26]] A member moved to recommend approval with the department's two conditions plus housing priority for Hāna residents where practical.[[1:03:22]] The motion passed with five votes in favor.[[1:09:44]] The next regular meeting is March 18, 2025, at 4:30 p.m.[[1:13:36]]
meeting.next: The applicant's consultant said the project must go back to the state land board for final approval after the district change.
